layout.title: Arena64
layout.description: Competitive online checkers — realtime matches, ratings, and leaderboards.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: An unexpected error occurred. You can try again or return home.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

common.errorSummary: The form could not be submitted

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to play on Arena64.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: A few seconds and you are playing.
register.successBody: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Some features stay limited until you open it.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.invalidBody: The link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
verifyEmail.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Copy the whole link from your email.
verifyEmail.resendSent: If an account exists for that address, we have sent a link.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your address and we will send a reset link.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, we have sent a reset link. Check your email.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter your new password twice.
resetPassword.successBody: You can sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Copy the whole link from your email.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email or password is wrong.
errors.account_locked: This account is temporarily locked. Try again later.
errors.invalid_token: Your session is not valid. Sign in again.
errors.expired_token: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_session: Your session is not valid. Sign in again.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_email: That email address is not valid.
errors.weak_password: That password is not strong enough.
errors.invalid_verification_token: That confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalid_reset_token: That reset link is invalid or has expired.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.

validation.emailInvalid: That email address is not valid.
validation.passwordWeak: Include an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter, a digit and a symbol.

session.unavailableTitle: We could not check your session
session.unavailableBody: The server could not be reached, so we could not tell whether you are signed in.
session.signOutFailed: Signing out on the server failed, but the session was cleared on this device.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.subtitle: This is what other players see on your public profile.

avatar.title: Photo
avatar.removeBody: Your profile photo will be deleted and your initials shown instead.
avatar.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. At most {max} MB.
avatar.tooLarge: That file is larger than {max} MB.
avatar.wrongType: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP are accepted.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Interface and gameplay settings.
preferences.themeNote: Light and dark are stored in this browser and never sent to the server.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Choose what appears on your public profile.
privacy.showCountryHint: Your country code appears on your public profile.
privacy.showStatisticsHint: Does not affect ratings — those are always public.
privacy.onlineStatusHint: Who can see that you are online.
privacy.lastSeenHint: Who can see when you were last online.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices signed in to your account.
sessions.signOutAllHint: Ends every session on every device, including this one.
sessions.confirmBody: You will have to sign in again on each device.
sessions.listDeferred: A device list is not available yet — the server does not publish one.

public.notFoundBody: There is no such username, or it has changed.

errors.avatar_too_large: That image is over the size limit.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.network: We could not reach the server.

search.title: Find players
search.label: Username or name
search.tooShort: Type at least {min} characters to search.

friends.title: Friends
friends.emptyHint: Find players and send them a request.

blocked.title: Blocked players
blocked.emptyHint: Blocked players do not appear in search or in your lists.

confirm.removeBody: {name} will be removed from your friends. They are not blocked, and you can send a request again later.
confirm.blockBody: {name} will not find you in search and cannot send you a request. An existing friendship ends and pending requests are cancelled.

errors.duplicate_friend_request: You have already sent this player a request.
errors.opposite_friend_request_pending: This player has sent you a request — check your incoming list.
errors.conflict: That is not possible right now.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.network: We could not reach the server.

form.modeHint: A rated game moves a permanent number.
form.timeControlHint: How long each side gets, and what a move gives back.

mode.casualHint: The result does not move your rating.

offer.title: You have an opponent
offer.description: Answer before the window closes — an unanswered offer expires.
offer.awaitingOpponent: You accepted. Waiting for your opponent.

game.boardPending: The board will load here in the next phase.

errors.match_resolved: That offer is no longer open.

errors.queue_cooldown_active: You declined a match recently. Please wait a moment.
errors.validation_error: That request was not valid. Check your selection.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have access to that.

errors.unavailable: The queue state could not be read.
errors.catalogue_unavailable: Games cannot be started right now. Try again later.

clock.label: {side} clock

errors.stale_state: Your view was out of date — refreshing it.

errors.room_unavailable: The game could not be joined.

incoming.body: Accept to end the game as a draw, or decline and keep playing.
